name: git-writer
description: A minimalistic, Git-backed markdown note-taking app for desktop and mobile
readme_summary: Git Writer is a minimalistic, cross-platform note-taking application that leverages Git repositories for version control and synchronization of Markdown notes across desktop and mobile devices. It aims to provide a seamless experience for managing notes across Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.
key_features: Cross-platform support (Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS)
Git-backed note storage for version control and synchronization
primary_use_case: A cross-platform note-taking application that uses Git for version control and synchronization of Markdown notes.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, open notebook with pages made of flowing digital Git commits, each commit a different version of a Markdown note. A gentle stream of these Git commit pages is flowing from a laptop on the left towards a smartphone on the right, symbolizing synchronization. Subtle lines of code and Git branch icons are subtly integrated into the background. The overall mood is organized and efficient, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a soft, glowing effect on the data flow, emphasizing the seamless transfer and versioning of notes.

name: glances
description: Glances an Eye on your system. A top/htop alternative for GNU/Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows operating systems.
readme_summary: Glances is an open-source, cross-platform system monitoring tool written in Python. It provides real-time insights into CPU, memory, disk, network, processes, and container usage through a user-friendly dashboard. It supports remote monitoring via a web interface or API, and can export data to various formats or databases.
key_features: Cross-platform system monitoring (Linux, macOS, Windows, BSD)
Real-time monitoring of CPU, memory, disk, network, processes, sensors, etc.
Data export to files (CSV) or databases
AI assistant integration via MCP server
primary_use_case: Real-time system and process monitoring across multiple platforms, with options for remote access and data export.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, old owl with a magnifying glass perched on a branch, looking down at a complex, interconnected network of glowing digital threads representing system resources (CPU, RAM, Network). The owl's eyes glow with data, and it's meticulously examining the threads, highlighting areas of high activity or potential issues with a beam of light. Subtle UI elements resembling a dashboard with graphs and numbers are integrated into the owl's perch. The background is a dark, starry sky, with the repository name 'Glances' subtly etched into a nearby constellation. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear iconography and a vibrant, data-driven color palette.

name: luna
readme_summary: Luna is a self-hosted calendar aggregator and frontend application that consolidates calendars from various protocols like CalDav, iCal, and Google Calendar into a single, customizable web interface. It offers extensive theming options and user management, aiming to provide a unified and personalized calendar experience.
key_features: Supports CalDav, iCal, and Google Calendar protocols
Single web application for all calendars
Simple installation of additional themes and fonts
primary_use_case: To provide a unified, customizable, and self-hosted interface for aggregating and viewing multiple digital calendars from different sources.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing and merging countless colorful scrolls (representing different calendars like CalDav, iCal, Google Calendar) onto a grand, illuminated central desk. The desk displays a single, beautifully rendered, and customizable calendar interface, showcasing a harmonious blend of events. Subtle digital particles flow from the scrolls to the desk, and small, stylized UI elements representing themes and fonts are visible on the desk's surface. The library is cozy and warm, with soft lighting. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration, emphasizing clarity and organization, with the name 'Luna' subtly etched on the librarian's spectacles.

name: ai-file-sorter
description: Cross-platform desktop application for content-aware file organization and renaming. Supports local and remote LLMs, preview-based workflows, and fully user-controlled changes.
readme_summary: AI File Sorter is a cross-platform desktop application designed to intelligently organize and rename files using AI. It supports local and remote LLMs, analyzes various file types including images, documents, audio, and video, and offers a preview-based workflow for user-controlled changes, ensuring privacy by design.
key_features: Analyzes image content, document text, and media metadata
Privacy-first design with local-only processing option
Combines AI suggestions with user-defined rules and history
primary_use_case: To automatically organize and rename files on a user's computer using AI, reducing clutter and improving file discoverability.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic robot librarian meticulously sorting and labeling books on a vast, organized shelf. Each book represents a file, with some having glowing icons indicating their content type (photo, document, music). The robot is using a holographic interface to scan book covers (representing file content analysis) and suggest new, clearer titles on glowing digital labels. Small, subtle UI elements showing file previews and suggested names float around the robot. The background is a clean, modern library with soft, ambient lighting. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a warm, inviting color palette, emphasizing order and intelligence. The repository name 'AI File Sorter' is subtly integrated into a sign on the library wall.
